rule: Historical public code may corroborate routing behaviors and motivate clean-room tests, but it never supplies live authority, normative requirements, or terminal verdict authority.

observedSeams: VRS verification is exposed as an adapter boundary rather than embedded directly into call signaling
an explicit iTRS mode chooses between local database lookup and an external lookup helper
the external helper is invoked in simple mode and returns a SIP URI as the durable lookup result
the public repository includes a sanitized testing replacement for the external lookup helper
simple mode performs the iTRS NAPTR lookup and returns the resulting SIP URI
full mode continues from the logical SIP URI through ordinary SIP NAPTR and SRV discovery
the queried owner reverses the ten-digit number and appends a .1 suffix under the iTRS namespace
a CNAME result is followed before selecting an E2U+sip record
multiple eligible records are sorted before the first result is selected
service discovery and provider endpoint mapping occur after the logical SIP URI is recovered
